authority: Existing Gravity PhysicalGraph and ANEProvider owners; this registry is a durable work queue and evidence index, not a promotion authority.
claim_boundary: A device list is not a placement result.
A plan row is not a latency result.
An organ result is not a complete-token result.
A result for one model, organ, shape, or representation does not transfer generically without cross-scope evidence.
No ANE candidate may displace the Metal route without source parity, capability, transfer/synchronization accounting, and protected complete-token evidence.

latest_generic_fixture_revalidation.scope: one public Core ML ios16.mul fixture; generic toolchain/device control only
latest_generic_fixture_revalidation.interpretation: The supported public toolchain is live and the fixture plan is reproducible, but this fixture is CPU-preferred. Its prediction time and plan cannot transfer to Flash, KIMI, or an ANE promotion claim.

current_provider_evidence.interpretation: public device and generic fixture-plan evidence exists, but the measured ANE atlas and model-scoped complete useful work do not

models.next_evidence: model-scoped Core ML authoring/plan plus matched CPU/GPU/ANE organ controls; no ANE number is currently earned

bounded_cpu_gpu_evidence.scope: exact source-BF16 Flash layer-0 linear-attention plus routed/shared MoE graph on one BOS embedding
bounded_cpu_gpu_evidence.interpretation: A real source-sealed CPU oracle and Metal graph exist at one bounded layer scope. They are not a matched sustained placement A/B and do not fill any complete-token CPU/GPU/ANE matrix cell.

models.next_evidence: repeat the bounded layer-0 graph under a clean measured CPU/GPU control protocol, then obtain a lawful public Core ML authoring/compile path and model-scoped MLComputePlan before ANE work

mega_kernel.meaning: One model-aware execution spine with backend-native stage implementations; not a claim that one monolithic vendor kernel exists.
mega_kernel.decode_state_contract: Model-scoped route/KV/recurrent regions persist across accepted decode steps. Prefix replay is explicitly not counted as decode; byte sizes and device residency remain unresolved until an exact lowering measures them.
mega_kernel.fusion_rule: source parity first; then measure complete useful work including transfer, synchronization, residency, and fallback
mega_kernel.owner: hcli.physical_graph plus native Rust/Metal lowerings as each primitive earns promotion

required_evidence_per_model: exact source seal and architecture anatomy
public Core ML device/plan placement for the exact operation
matched CPU, GPU, ANE, and relevant concurrent controls
transfer, synchronization, residency, and fallback accounting
independent review before any backend promotion
current_blockers: system Core ML authoring dependency coremltools is absent
the active developer directory is CommandLineTools rather than a full Xcode developer directory; public fixture probes work, but the Core ML authoring dependency is absent
no Flash-specific compiled MLProgram or MLComputePlan evidence exists
no ANE latency, throughput, energy, capability, or complete-token result is claimed
reopen_conditions: a model-specific graph can be compiled without bypassing platform security boundaries
MLComputePlan and runtime placement are observed for the exact model/organ
protected complete-token A/B shows useful work improvement over the current route
next_action: Keep this lane open in Odyssey; characterize KIMI and Flash per model as toolchain permits, keep Metal primary, and lower repeated stages into the shared MegaKernel spine without claiming ANE execution before evidence.
